title: NVIDIA Releases Nemotron-Cascade 2: An Open 30B MoE with 3B Active Parameters

key_discoveries.title: Multi-Domain On-Policy Distillation (MOPD)
key_discoveries.description: Token-level distillation advantage from best intermediate teacher models during Cascade RL. Reaches teacher-level AIME25 performance in 30 steps vs GRPO's lower score in same budget. Substantially more sample-efficient than sequence-level reward algorithms.
key_discoveries.actionability: Phase 3+ — relevant if doing custom post-training; not immediately applicable on Claude Max flat rate

key_discoveries.title: Nemotron-Cascade 2 as local inference tier candidate
key_discoveries.description: 30B MoE with 3B active parameters — open-weight, Gold Medal reasoning, purpose-built tool calling (`<tools>`/`<tool_call>` XML) and thinking mode toggle (`<think>`). NVIDIA's Privacy Router in OpenShell can route inference to local Nemotron models. Candidate for sub-frontier cost tier in Phase 3+ model routing.
key_discoveries.actionability: Phase 3+ — only relevant when we leave Claude Max flat rate and need cost-tiered model routing

deep_dive_candidates.reason: Full technical paper with complete MOPD math, Cascade RL pipeline stages, and benchmark tables
